pages.text: Early on you get $(l)Blast Bricks$() and $(l)Coal Coke$() by looting structures, not by crafting them.$(br2)$(l)Blast Bricks:$()$(li)The tall stone-brick tower with a ladder in the middle (pumpkin spiders nearby).

The ladder hangs on blast bricks. Two towers is usually enough.$(li)$(l)Troll campfires$() (with a copper chest).$(li)A 3x3 patch of black grass ringed by upside-down quartz stairs hides 9 blast bricks underneath.$(li)A house built from Thaumcraft blocks.

$(l)Coal Coke:$() the $(l)Coke Library$() (full of book spawners) has a roof made of coal coke blocks. It's easier to spot in open areas without many trees or much water. The library also contains an $(l)Elytra$().
